title: Brazilian Beef Roast
description: A deliciously aromatic beef roast, inspired by Brazilian flavors, perfect for a Sunday dinner.
instructions: Season the beef roast with salt, black pepper, and aromatic amazingly roast spice blend.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the beef roast on all sides until browned, about 2 minutes per side.
Remove the beef from the pot and set it aside. Reduce heat to medium and cook the sliced onions until they start to caramelize, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the sliced green pepper and cook until it starts to soften, about 2 minutes.
Add the crushed tomatoes, Brazilian coffee, and a pinch of salt. Stir to combine.
Return the beef roast to the pot, cover it with a lid, and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the beef for 2.5 hours, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 63°C (145°F) for medium-rare.
Remove the pot from the oven and let the beef rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve with the rich, flavorful sauce spooned over the top.
